summary: Two defendants are each charged with two counts of discharging a firearm from a vehicle, Class A felonies carrying a gang modifier on the court file, over an incident on Nov. 21 at Fairbanks; neither is named here because the court record places each under 18 at the time. A Fairbanks man is charged with thirty counts of unlawful contact in violation of a court order and violating felony release conditions, on offenses dated between Aug. 31 and Nov. 13. The Fairbanks court opened seven criminal files on Nov. 26 and Nov. 27, troopers reported drink-driving arrests in Fairbanks on Nov. 27 and early on Nov. 28, and two defendants who missed arraignments on Nov. 27 had warrants ordered against them. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report for Nov. 21 to Nov. 27 lists 38 criminal files at Fairbanks and prints no section at all for Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction; the counts below are the report's own. It also omits one Fairbanks case number, 4FA-26-02342CR, that the court's own case database serves in full, and prints one, 4FA-26-02346CR, that the database has not returned since Nov. 25.

entries.title: Two charged with firing a gun from a vehicle in Fairbanks
body: Two defendants are each charged with two counts of misconduct involving weapons in the first degree - discharging a firearm from a propelled vehicle - Class A felonies, punishable under Alaska law by up to 20 years. All four counts carry a gang charge modifier on the court file.

The offenses are dated Nov. 21, 2026, at Fairbanks. Both charges were brought on complaints by the Alaska State Troopers, one filed Nov. 26 and one filed Nov. 27. Both defendants were arraigned Nov. 27 and both cases stand at preliminary hearings on Dec. 7 and Dec. 17 before Judge Earl A. Peterson.

Neither defendant is named here and the case numbers are not published: the court record gives each a date of birth placing him under 18 at the time of the offense. This record does not name juveniles.

entries.title: Thirty counts of unlawful contact and release violations: Isaiah Joseph Weeks
body: Isaiah Joseph Weeks is charged with thirty counts: fifteen of unlawful contact in violation of a court order - contacting a person a court order forbids him to contact - each flagged domestic violence related, and fifteen of violating a condition of release for a felony. All thirty are Class A misdemeanors.
The offenses are dated between Aug. 31 and Nov. 13, 2026, at Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02347CR. The court issued a warrant on Nov. 27 with bail set at $500, performance.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Blake Carroll
body: Blake Carroll was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence, recorded by troopers as DUI. Van Horn Road area, Fairbanks, Nov. 28 at about 2:25 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say a Ford F-250 was stopped after several traffic violations, that the driver showed signs of impairment and said he had been drinking before driving, and that a preliminary breath test and a later breath sample each read 0.109. Troopers say an open container of alcohol and marijuana paraphernalia were found in the vehicle. He was remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

entries.title: DUI charge: Roman Anthony Perea
body: Roman Anthony Perea is charged with one count of driving under the influence - operating a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs - a Class A misdemeanor. The court's weekly charges report records a blood alcohol figure of .140 on the count. Fairbanks, Nov. 27; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say he was stopped after several traffic violations, performed poorly on field sobriety tests, gave a preliminary breath sample of .166, and was taken for an independent blood draw before being remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02355CR; arraignment Dec. 4.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Philip Oryne Prince
